options.title: Items waiting at the SAIL check
options.how: Items in the delivery_live workflow's sail_check waiting pile, read from the piles instrument each round (a level, so it is a stock)
options.caveat: Counts workflow items in that pile, which are taken to be the pull requests; it does not separate pull requests from other items if the pile holds any.

options.title: Items waiting at the SAIL step

options.caveat: A different step from the SAIL check: it counts items queued for SAIL, not those already at the check. Use it if the owner means the whole SAIL stage.

github.title: github
github.description: Named by workflow delivery_live: the outside system github, known by the actors its bridge relays.

steps: delivery_live · open_pr: outside github; done when github.pr.opened; done → ci; on github.pr.synchronize → ci; guard within 1200 s, then attention
delivery_live · ci: outside github; done when github.checks.completed with head_sha = the item's commit; success → review, failure → write; guard within 1800 s, then attention

delivery_live · review: outside github; done when github.pr.reviewed with state = setting review_state; done → sail; on github.pr.reviewed with state = "changes_requested" → write; guard within 1800 s, then attention

delivery_live · sail_check: outside github; done when github.pr.labeled with label = "SAILED"; done → close_ticket; on github.pr.labeled with label = "REJECTED" → triage; guard at most 3 rounds, then attention
spec.source: bot.github, bot.github.<login> and person.github.<login> (relayed by its bridge)

review_nudger.title: Review Nudger
review_nudger.description: Reminds the reviewer when a pull request has waited too long for its review or for SAIL.

invariants: Never changes code or merges anything; it only reminds the reviewer and proposes work.
Reminds only for a pull request that has waited longer than the wait threshold for its review or for SAIL.
Reads the events it listens for at each run; it never acts on a pull request that is already merged.
steps: 1. At 09:00 each day, read github.pr.opened, github.pr.reviewed and github.pr.merged to know which pull requests are open and when each started waiting for review.
2. Read sail.check.completed to know when each pull request entered or left the SAIL check.
3. For each open pull request waiting longer than the threshold for review or SAIL, remind its reviewer.
4. Read the level of prs_waiting_for_sail as the count of pull requests waiting on SAIL.

provenance.author: owner
provenance.message: Create a machine called Review Nudger: when a pull request has waited too long for its review or for SAIL, it reminds the reviewer. It should listen for the GitHub pull request events and the SAIL check results on the bus. Make it a scheduled task for 9am every day. Then confirm it. I expect SAILED per day ×1.2.
provenance.quote: Create a machine called Review Nudger: when a pull request has waited too long for its review or for SAIL, it reminds the reviewer.
provenance.reason: The owner wants pull requests that wait too long for review or SAIL to get a reminder to the reviewer.
